given: a SKU holds stock at more than one location
when: a warehouse operator opens the detail view for that SKU
then: one row is shown per location where that SKU holds stock, each carrying that location and its quantity for the SKU
architectural_notes: E2E: exercises the outermost boundary the operator opens (the React SPA detail view under client/) rendering data from the JSON boundary (app/routes/) that calls stock-service (app/services/) to query stock_records filtered by SKU and grouped per location via stock-repository (app/repositories/, the only layer touching the ORM/session) against the paired branch DB. The per-location fan-out is a read aggregation owned by the service; the boundary returns JSON (R5/NFR-F1-5), the SPA renders one row per location. No cross-cutting write concerns (read-only path; V1 has no auth). Verified via the R4 real-branch integration suite on the boundary collection response plus SPA component tests.
